bones: Every clip keys the rotation of all 87 bones of this body (tripo-player-ue5: the UE5 names less jaw, eye_l and eye_r) as real glTF local rotations (rest included: a bone at rest holds its node rotation, which here is Tripo's T-pose bind, not the canonical pose), and the translation of root, pelvis, ik_foot_l, ik_foot_r, ik_hand_gun, ik_hand_l, ik_hand_r. Authored in canonical frames: local[b] = R[p]^-1 * canonicalLocal[b] * R[b] with R from tripo-player-ue5.frames.json. Exact mapping from the old skeleton: spine_02 / spine_04 / neck_02 and the metacarpals at their canonical locals. Twist bones keyed with this body's refit shares (frames file twistBones): local = canonicalLocal * twistY(share * a), canonicalLocal including the forearm's pre-turn; lowerarm_twist_02 / _01 = 0.834 / 0.879 of the hand's twist about the forearm, calf_twist_02 / _01 = 0.411 / 0.393 of the foot's about the shin, upperarm_twist_01 / _02 = -0.501 / -0.100 and thigh_twist_01 / _02 = -0.304 / -0.026 of the bone's own twist (swing-twist about +Y measured from the canonical local, unwrapped frame to frame; no clip winds a whole turn). IK bones: ik_foot_l/r = the feet's transforms in the root's space (ik_foot_root at rest), ik_hand_gun = hand_r (ik_hand_root at rest), ik_hand_l = hand_l in ik_hand_gun's frame, ik_hand_r = identity (ik_hand_gun's twin).
clipSpace: Each clip is authored in its vehicle root's own glTF frame (vehicle_root / helicopter_root: +Y up, forward -Z, right +X, metres). notes `root` per frame [x, z, yaw]: where the character stands or sits on that frame's ground plane: root world (in the vehicle) = T(x, 0, z) * Ry(yaw); the character faces (sin yaw, 0, cos yaw), so yaw = pi faces the vehicle's forward. The root BONE keys the same track (rifle packs' rule: a player that places the character by notes `root` holds the root bone at rest). Height comes from the pelvis.
seatedReference: car-drive frame 0 and heli-fly frame 0 are the seated reference poses (each loop's life is added on top and is exactly zero at frame 0). The one-pose clips (car-steer-l/-r, car-look-back, heli-cyclic-*, heli-collective-*, heli-pedal-*) are whole-body poses built on that reference with only the control (and what follows it) changed: blend them ADDITIVELY over the loop, per bone delta = pose * reference^-1 (rotation; translation difference for pelvis), weighted by the control's share of its extreme (e.g. wheel angle / 90 deg), so the loop keeps the body alive; between two opposite extremes use one at a time by sign. Hands and feet: pin them with IK to the clip's `contacts` on the live node every frame, which makes the blend exact at the hands.

car.door: door_L: local rotation = rest * Rx(-55 deg * door), door 0 shut .. 1 open (the GLB's doors_open)
car.wheel: steering_wheel: local rotation = rest * Ry(wheel deg), glTF local +Y = the column towards the driver (the spec's Blender "local Z"); + = turned left. car-steer-l = +90, car-steer-r = -90; car-drive moves it +-3.7 deg (notes `wheel` per frame)

heli.door: cockpit_door_R: local rotation = rest * Ry(+68 deg * door)
heli.cyclic: cyclic: local rotation = rest * Rx(-fwd) * Rz(-right) about its floor pivot; heli-cyclic-f/-b fwd = +9.0 / -6.0 deg, -l/-r right = -/+6.0 deg
heli.collective: collective: local rotation = rest * Rx(coll) (+ raises the grip); heli-collective-down / -up coll = 4.0 / +20.0 deg, heli-fly holds 13.0
heli.pedals: pedal_L / pedal_R: translated along the parent's -Z by +-push; heli-pedal-l pushes the left pedal 0.045 m forward and the right one back by the same, -r the reverse

controls.note: Per clip, notes `ctl` holds the controls per frame (only those that move). The game's own control ranges may differ: scale the pose clips' weights to them; the contacts follow the nodes either way.

events: seconds from the clip's start: doorOpenStart, doorOpenEnd, seated, doorCloseStart, doorCloseEnd, handsOn (exit clips: doorOpenStart / -End, unseated (the hips leave the seat), doorCloseStart / -End, handsOff). Pass A4: handsOn (enter clips) = the hands on the wheel / the controls, driving or flying input live from here; free (exit clips) = standing clear of the door, movement input may take over from here (the door, if not shut, closes by itself). The fast entry / exit clips (A4) are the same moves as before at a speed-limited pace (holds shortened, the moves as brisk as the limits allow); car-exit and heli-exit end standing where the body got out (no steps back to the entry point), and their doors close by themselves after free (no hand).
door: per frame 0 shut .. 1 open: the game drives the real door node from it (see controls).
contacts: list of {part: hand_l | hand_r | foot_l | foot_r, from, to (frames, inclusive), node (vehicle node name, or null = the ground / the vehicle root's frame), at: [x, y, z] in that node's own glTF frame (the palm's middle for a hand, the ball of the foot (point: ball) or the back of the heel (point: heel) for a foot), kind}. Pin the part to that point with IK while the node moves (the door handle rises with the door, the rim turns with the wheel, the grips move with the sticks). kinds: grip (closed hand round a rim / stick / handle), handle, push (flat hand), rest (hand or foot resting on a surface), press (foot on a pedal), step (foot taking weight), ground.
gun: Gun keys the rifle's sling place (rifle-motion's stow, chest frame) in every clip: no gun in the hands. The game puts the held gun on the back with the outgoing half of the swap clip before car-enter / heli-enter and hides both guns once the door is shut (VEHICLE_NOTES.md).

seat_driver.why: seat slid fully forward on its rails (0.20 m) and down (0.03 m)

steering_wheel.why: wheel telescoped 0.06 m towards the driver along its column

pilot_seat.why: seat 0.145 m forward: the backrest against the back as the hands hold the controls (pass A3)

athleticClips: Pass A4. car-bail (car frame) and heli-jump (helicopter frame) are like the entry / exit clips (the vehicle root's frame, root [x, z, yaw] on its ground plane, door per frame, contacts) and start exactly on car-drive frame 0 / heli-fly frame 0; events.release is the frame the body is clear of the vehicle: from there the game carries the body in world space with the vehicle's velocity. Their last frame is airborne (pelvis 0.90 m over the car's ground plane / 1.27 m over the helicopter's), root yaw = the body's facing. bail-roll, fall, land-roll, land-hard are ground clips: the clip's own frame, ground y = 0, the travel along -Z, root [x, z, yaw] from where the body starts. bail-roll frame 0 = car-bail's last frame re-rooted (same pose about the root, root (0, 0, car-bail's last root yaw)): its frame is the car's at the release, moved to the body (-Z = the car's forward, the travel at speed); its pelvis starts 0.90 m over its ground, the right shoulder meets it at events.ground; scale the root's x / z travel to the speed. fall is a loop with its root fixed at (0, 0, pi), the pelvis 1.10 m over the root, facing the root's yaw; car-bail's and heli-jump's last poses are near its frame 0 (one arm lower at their ends, by about 0.3 m: a 0.2 s blend). land-roll / land-hard start exactly on fall frame 0 (pelvis 1.10 m over their ground, the soles 0.14 m over it), the feet down at events.ground; free = standing, movement may take over.
parachuteClips: Pass A4. Ground-frame clips like the athletic ones (forward -Z, ground y = 0, root [x, z, yaw]). The toggles are at the palms (the hands' palm points, every frame), the risers meet the harness at clavicle_l / clavicle_r. para-hang: a 2 s loop, root fixed at (0, 0, pi), the pelvis 1.10 m over the root (as fall), hands up at the toggles. para-steer-l / -r / para-flare: one-pose clips equal to para-hang frame 0 except the pulled arm(s) (left / right / both hands down at the hips): add them over para-hang per bone (delta = pose * para-hang frame 0 ^-1) weighted by how far the toggle is pulled. para-deploy: from fall frame 0 exactly to para-hang frame 0 (1.4 mm at a hand); events.pull = the handle out of its pocket at the right hip, events.open = the opening jerk. para-land: from para-hang frame 0 exactly; the flare (hands to the hips), feet first at events.ground, three steps, standing at events.free, 2.0 m along -Z. para-pickup: standing to standing (pelvis 0.895 m, hands by the thighs), the pack on a crate 0.45 m ahead, its top 0.55 m up; events.grab = both hands on it; from grab to events.onBack the pack goes with the right palm, after it on spine_05; arms stay in front of / above the shoulders (clear of a 12 cm pack on the back), the right hand over the right shoulder in the swing.
vehicleFitNote: Fixed adjustments of the vehicle for this body family (a driver / pilot setting the seat, the wheel, the pedals): translate = an offset in the node's PARENT frame (here the vehicle root), added to its rest translation; the clips (root, contacts, poses) are authored with them applied: the game must apply the same offsets to the real model (a helper point moves with its seat).
